messages:
alex_cs: FYI - seeing a spike in provisioning auth errors for new onboarders in APAC since ~08:15 UTC. Affected: ~120 tenants stuck in 'provisioning'. tagging for priority outreach.

maria_eng: looking into logs now, seems 401 from our VPC auth proxy intermittently. fetching correlated errors.

opsbot: Incident detected: PROV_AUTH_502 - Rate 0.7% -> Escalated to oncall.

maria_eng: root cause candidate: token refresh loop when KMS latency > 300ms. running traces show repeated refresh attempts for some sessions.

jamie_se: CS ask: which accounts are high-touch? we need list to triage renewal risk.

alex_cs: pulling list, will prioritize accounts with trial>50 seats + any in active renewal window. initial list attached (internal): tenant-ids redacted for thread.

linda_csm: Draft customer note suggestion:
```
Hi <Customer>,
We're investigating provisioning delays impacting tenant onboarding. We're prioritizing your account and will provide an ETA within 2 hours. Apologies for the disruption.
```

maria_eng: ETA: rollout of hotfix to proxy in 20-30m, then backfill provisioning queue; estimated catch-up time ~90 min after patch.

alex_cs: Plan: send targeted DM to top 25 impacted immediately, broader email in 1h, follow-up RCA within 72h. Offer one week of waived onboarding overage credits for high-impacted customers. Thoughts?

linda_csm: +1. Also schedule office hours for affected customers tomorrow 14:00 UTC.

jamie_se: Add a one-click feedback form link in the follow-up so we can capture impact severity and use the data for renewal score updates. Use short form + NPS field.

maria_eng: After hotfix we'll run a script to requeue stalled jobs: `./tools/requeue_provisioning.sh --filter auth-fail` should be safe.

alex_cs: ok sending DMs now. I'll post the customer note in #customer-updates once DMs dispatched. tagging @sara_legal for any wording constraints.

sara_legal: quick note - avoid promising credits as 'guaranteed' in public email, frame as 'we will evaluate credits for impacted accounts' and confirm in follow-up.

alex_cs: got it, adjust wording. I'll attach the one-pager RCA template to the follow-up.

opsbot: Status update: hotfix deployed v2.1.1proxy -> 08:41 UTC. Error rate dropping.

alex_cs: update to customers sent. Monitoring catch-up. Will compile affected-account spreadsheet and share in the morning for renewal team.

linda_csm: thanks team. capture any customer feedback in #cs-feedback with tenant-id tag.

jamie_se: Recording this for renewal risk scoring: will mark 12 accounts as 'high-risk' pending feedback.

alex_cs: Last: if anything changes ping me. Closing standup thread, will reopen if new regression.
